title: A Generalized FC-Gram Approximation Framework with Analysis and Applications
summary: The FC-Gram algorithm constructs high-order trigonometric approximations of nonperiodic functions by periodically extending them to a larger interval, with the quality of the blending continuation of Gram polynomials over the extension interval directly governing the approximation accuracy. We introduce GenFC, a generalized FC-Gram framework in which the continuation of each Gram polynomial is shaped by a cutoff function satisfying prescribed boundary flatness conditions.
